headline: Fronts Flare as Ownership Shifts Accelerate
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the heaviest fighting has deepened on six sectors. Weathered Expanse now records 41 ownership changes in the past day — up from 39 — with 9,870 Colonial and 10,647 Warden casualties and 426 fresh enlistments. Mooring County follows with 31 flips, 10,434 Colonial and 10,377 Warden dead, and 1,229 new troops arriving. Stlican Shelf shows 14 changes centred on Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, adding 2,283 Colonial and 2,467 Warden losses and 420 enlistments. Palantine Berm erupts with 11 flips, driving its toll to 1,892 Colonial and 2,380 Warden casualties while 517 soldiers join the fight. Farranac Coast and Linn Mercy each log three flips; Farranac adds 1,321 Colonial and 2,066 Warden dead with 292 enlistments, while Linn Mercy adds 170 Colonial and 145 Warden casualties and 331 enlistments. Callahans Passage registers two recent captures, but the bulk of rear‑area regions remain static with no ownership moves reported.
